english:
A slightly homing grenade with a light trajectory that sticks to enemies or surfaces and explodes after a brief delay.

The explosion deals up to <pve 738 /> <pvp [130] /> damage to enemies within 6 meters and applies 40 stacks of <solar Scorch />. <solar Ember of Ashes /> adds 20 more stacks.

source.text:
Light Trajectory | Slightly Homing | Sticky

Attaches to enemies or surfaces, exploding after a brief delay.

Explosion deals up to 738 [130] damage and inflict x40+20 Scorch over 6 meters on detonation.
Base Cooldown: 95.8 seconds

Chunk Scalar:  1x
